custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' of the small metal beads at the bottom of the pendant. In AI images, these often fail to render as distinct spheres with clear attachment points. Also, check if the chain links maintain consistent thickness and topology throughout the drape, or if they warp/melt into the background fabric in shadowed areas.
